import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n, i;
    static char[] s = new char[70];
    static long[][] comb = new long[70][70];

    static int[] cnt_a = new int[70];
    static int[] cnt_b = new int[70];
    static List<Long>[] partial = new List[70];
    static List<Long>[] partial_zero = new List[70];

    static void compute_comb() {
        int j;
        for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        int i;
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;

        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                a_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void compute_second_part() {
        int conf;
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        int a_here, b_here;

        for (conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            a_here = c + 1 - b_here;

            if (check(conf)) {
                long val = get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here);
                partial[a_here].add(val);
            } else {
                long val = get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here);
                partial_zero[a_here].add(val);
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_coef(int conf) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1)) {
                break;
            }
        }

        for (j = i; j < c + 1; j++) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }

        int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);

        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(Pair ans, Pair act) {
        if (act.first < 0) act.first = -act.first;

        if (ans.first < act.first) return;
        if (ans.first > act.first) {
            ans.first = act.first;
            ans.second = act.second;
            return;
        }

        ans.second += act.second;
    }

    static long how_many(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int it1 = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (it1 < 0) it1 = -it1 - 1;
        
        int it2 = it1;
        while (it2 < data.size() && data.get(it2).equals(val)) {
            it2++;
        }
        
        return it2 - it1;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int conf;
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        int a_here, b_here;
        long act, coef, coef2;
        Pair ans = new Pair(1L << 60, 0);

        for (conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);

            coef = get_coef(conf);
            List<Long> list = partial[c + 1 - a_here];
            int it_index = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (it_index < 0) it_index = -it_index - 1;

            if (it_index < list.size()) {
                long val = list.get(it_index);
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(list, val);
                    Pair newPair = new Pair(val + act, coef * coef2);
                    upd(ans, newPair);
                }
            }

            if (it_index > 0) {
                it_index--;
                long val = list.get(it_index);
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(list, val);
                    Pair newPair = new Pair(val + act, coef * coef2);
                    upd(ans, newPair);
                }
            }

            coef = 0;
            list = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here];
            it_index = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (it_index < 0) it_index = -it_index - 1;

            if (it_index < list.size()) {
                long val = list.get(it_index);
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(list, val);
                    Pair newPair = new Pair(val + act, coef * coef2);
                    upd(ans, newPair);
                }
            }

            if (it_index > 0) {
                it_index--;
                long val = list.get(it_index);
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(list, val);
                    Pair newPair = new Pair(val + act, coef * coef2);
                    upd(ans, newPair);
                }
            }
        }

        return ans.second;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        long second;

        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        r = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        String str = sc.next();
        s = (" " + str).toCharArray();

        n = 2 * (r + c);

        for (i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partial_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        compute_comb();

        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        compute_second_part();
        long sol = compute_first_part();

        System.out.println(sol);
    }
}
